items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: And then he was also in Sidney Desvinge's band when I played with him.

ctx.x: And Houston, William Houston came into Rene's band after that. And then he was also in Sidney Desvinge's band when I played with him.
